'''Dezfuli''' ({{langx|fa|دزفولی}} [dezfuːˈliː]) is one of the southwestern dialects of [[Iran]], which is the dialect of a part of the people of [[Dezful]], who are known as Dezfuli. Dezfuli and [[Shushtari dialect|Shushtari]] share common features with the surrounding [[Luri language|Luri dialects]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=MacKinnon |first=Colin |date=2015 |title=Dezfūlī and Šūštari Dialects |url=https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/dezful-03-dialect |access-date= |website=[[Encyclopædia Iranica]] |language=en-US}}</ref> [[Glottolog]] places Dezfuli-Shushatri dialects in a group called [[Luri language|Luri]]-Dezfuli, which, while being separate from [[Luri language|Luri]] and [[New Persian]], have a similar status to [[Luri language]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Pensado |first1=Carmen |last2=Repetti |first2=Lori |date=January 2003 |title=Phonological Theory and the Dialects of Italy |url=https://doi.org/10.2307/3738241 |journal=The Modern Language Review |volume=98 |issue=1 |pages=220 |doi=10.2307/3738241 |jstor=3738241 |issn=0026-7937|url-access=subscription }}</ref> However, other linguists indicate that Dezfuli is a dialect of the [[Persian language|Persian]] language that has been influenced by [[Luri language|Luri]].<ref>{{cite web|archive-date=2020-11-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201118190103/https://iranicaonline.org/articles/dezful-03-dialect |url-status=live |publisher=[[Encyclopædia Iranica]] |title=Shushtari-Dezfuli Dialects |url=https://iranicaonline.org/articles/dezful-03-dialect}}</ref><ref name="KHUZESTANviii">{{cite web|archive-date=2020-11-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201119013124/https://iranicaonline.org/articles/khuzestan-08-dialects |url-status=live |publisher=[[Encyclopædia Iranica]] |title=Khuzestan viii. Dialects |url=http://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/khuzestan-08-dialects}}</ref>In the article on the dialects of Khuzestan, Iranika considers the Dezfuli-Shoshtri and [[Bakhtiari dialect|Bakhtiari dialects]] to belong to the southern group of the [[Luri language]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Iranica Khuzestan dialects |url=https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/khuzestan-08-dialects}}</ref>
